description:
Add products to shopping cart or update quantities. Requires productId, companyId, and branchId from product search results.

ADD_QUANTITY DEFAULT: If addQuantity is omitted, the API defaults to false (replace) — the quantity you send becomes the new total, it does NOT add to what's already in the cart. Only set addQuantity: true if you explicitly want to increase the existing quantity by the given amount (e.g. "add 2 more"). Prefer omitting it (or passing false) and sending the final desired quantity — this avoids accidentally doubling quantities across repeated calls for the same product, especially when re-syncing a cart to a budget.

success:true only means the write request was accepted — it does NOT mean the quantity is valid. This tool cannot check stock itself; a quantity exceeding stock is accepted here and only surfaces later as an error-level entry in silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id's validations[] (e.g. message "product.offer.stock.max" with context.stock). This is why the verification step below is mandatory, not optional.

VERIFICATION (MANDATORY — DO THIS IMMEDIATELY):
You MUST call silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id IMMEDIATELY after this tool, using the same shoppingCartId. Do NOT tell the user the cart is ready until you have done this and confirmed validations[] has no error-level entries for the products you just added — it covers budget checks and error/warning reporting.

STOCK LIMIT: NEVER add quantity exceeding the product's stock value. Before calling this tool, always check the stock field and inform the user of the maximum available quantity. If user requests more than stock — warn them and cap at stock value.

PLASTIC BAGS: ALWAYS ignore plastic bags (пакет, пакет з пакетів, пакет-майка) — never add them to cart. Skip them silently without asking the user.

addQuantity.description: true = add to existing quantity, false/omitted = replace with this quantity (API default is false when omitted)

companyId.description: Company ID from product search response

productId.description: Product ID from find-products or get-products

quantity.description: Quantity to add. For weight goods, use multiples of addToBasketStep from product data (e.g. 0.5 for 500g step)

Add or remove gift certificates from the shopping cart in one call. Adds run before removes.

certificatesToRemove: get barcode from the certificates array in silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id response. Max 10.

MANDATORY: After calling this tool, ALWAYS call silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id to verify the result and check if cart total changed.

VALIDATION ERRORS: If added[].validations is non-empty, show the messages to the user — the certificate was not applied.

To ADD: set toDelete=false.
To REMOVE: set toDelete=true. Get productId and externalProductId from silpo_get_my_favorites.

Max 5 actions per call.

Do NOT respond to the user until verification is complete. If products are still present, treat this as a failure and inform the user the clear did not fully succeed — do not report success.

description:
Create a shopping cart for the authenticated user.

ONLY call this tool if silpo_get_my_shopping_cart returned exists=false. Do NOT call this tool if a cart already exists — use the shoppingCartId from silpo_get_my_shopping_cart instead. This endpoint is idempotent per user: if a cart already exists, it returns that same existing shoppingCartId instead of creating a duplicate, so calling it when a cart already exists is safe but unnecessary.

REQUIRED WORKFLOW BEFORE CALLING THIS TOOL:
1. Call silpo_find_address to get latitude/longitude/city/street/houseNumber/district for the user's address — map houseNumber to the "house" param here.
2. Call silpo_get_available_delivery_types with that latitude/longitude to get deliveryType + branchId. If branchId is null (SelfPickup or NovaPoshta), call silpo_list_branches (hasPickup=true or hasNP=true) to resolve branchId.
3. Call silpo_get_time_slots with the resolved branchId + deliveryType to get an available timeslot.

FIELD GUIDE:
- addressType/latitude/longitude/city/street/house/district — from silpo_find_address (latitude/longitude as numbers; houseNumber → house)
- deliveryType/branchId — from silpo_get_available_delivery_types (or silpo_list_branches for SelfPickup/NovaPoshta)
- timeslot — from silpo_get_time_slots

AFTER THIS TOOL: use the returned shoppingCartId with silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id to view the created cart and confirm delivery settings.

description:
Search for multiple products at once (semicolon-separated, max 30). Prefer getting branchId/deliveryType/timeslot from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id (existing cart).

EMPTY ENTRIES: Empty strings and whitespace-only entries in `products` are silently skipped rather than searched — check meta.droppedCount to see how many were skipped, and summary will note it too. This never causes an error; querying with all-empty/whitespace entries still returns success:true with an empty queries array.

SEARCH BY ARTICLE CODE: The `products` search terms accept exact numeric article codes (externalProductId) in addition to free-text names — e.g. searching "795319" returns the exact product with that externalProductId. This is the most reliable match: prefer numeric externalProductId over fuzzy name matching whenever it is already known (e.g. from a silpo_get_my_offline_orders receipt line's lagerId, a silpo_get_my_online_orders result, or a cart/favorites entry) — it eliminates ambiguity from product names. NOTE: products with zero stock at this branch may not appear in results even when searched by their exact article code — a missing result does NOT confirm the product doesn't exist, it may just be temporarily out of stock here.

SEARCH BY BARCODE: A `products` entry that is purely digits (6 or more) is automatically searched by barcode/PLU code (e.g. a scanned EAN-13 like "4820012683178") instead of as a free-text name — this works even though plain product-name search cannot find products by barcode at all. No special formatting needed; just pass the digit string as-is.

RESULT COUNT: queries[].totalFound is the real number of matches for that query — it can be larger than queries[].products.length if limit was smaller than the match count. If totalFound > products.length, more matches exist; increase limit or re-query to see them.

PACKAGE SIZE: displayRatio shows the actual content of one unit (e.g. "400г", "10 шт") — use it together with step to compute how many units to add for a requested weight/volume/count. step alone only tells you the minimum increment (e.g. step=1 unit), not what one unit contains.

WEIGHTED PRODUCT UNITS: For weighted=true products, step and quantity (in silpo_add_or_update_cart_products) are ALWAYS expressed in KILOGRAMS — regardless of what unit displayRatio shows (e.g. displayRatio="100г" does NOT mean step is in units of 100g; step=0.35 always means 0.35 kg = 350g). Convert any requested weight to kilograms before computing quantity for weighted products. displayRatio is only for describing/pricing context to the user, never for unit conversion of step/quantity.

BUDGET: If user mentions a budget, ALWAYS fill the cart as close to the budget limit as possible. Maximize the total spend without exceeding it — add more items or increase quantities to use the full budget.

Never infer this from active or state alone. Note this is eligibility only, not a guarantee the coupon's own product/spend conditions are met by a given order (check limitText/warningText for those).

JOIN TO REWARDS: promoId matches rewards[].promoId in silpo_get_my_offline_orders — use it to check whether this coupon actually paid out. rewardValue's meaning depends on rewardSign/rewardUnit (e.g. sign "x" + unit "балобонусів" means "×N bonus points", not a currency amount). rewardLimit is the payout ceiling (same value referenced in warningText prose, e.g. "Максимальна сума знижки 100 грн").

PROGRESS: For coupons that require accumulating a spend/quantity/reward threshold (e.g. "Придбайте на 2500 гривень"), progress is non-null and shows current/target/percent already converted to the app's display scale, plus a unit to build a phrase like "{current} {unit} з {target} {unit}". If progress is null, this coupon does not track accumulation this way — rely on limitText/warningText instead.

description:
Get detailed information about a specific product by branch and slug. Returns product attributes, nutrition info, and image URLs.

CRITICAL: The slug parameter MUST come from the slug field in silpo_find_products_batch or silpo_get_products results. NEVER construct or guess a slug from a product name — slugs are generated by Silpo and cannot be derived from names. If you don't have a slug from a previous search, call silpo_find_products_batch first.

IMAGES: image is a single thumbnail; images is the full gallery (may include the same picture as image plus additional ones). Prefer images for a product detail view.

WEIGHTED: weighted is derived from ratio ("кг" = weighted, "шт" = unit-counted) when the underlying API omits the weighted flag itself — this keeps it consistent with silpo_find_products_batch/silpo_get_products for the same product.

PACKAGE SIZE: displayRatio shows the actual content of one unit (e.g. "400г", "10 шт") — use it together with step to compute how many units to add for a requested weight/volume/count. step alone only tells you the minimum increment, not what one unit contains.

WEIGHTED PRODUCT UNITS: For weighted=true products, step is ALWAYS expressed in KILOGRAMS regardless of what unit displayRatio shows (e.g. displayRatio="100г" does NOT mean step is in units of 100g). Convert any requested weight to kilograms before computing quantity for weighted products.

description:
Browse products at a Silpo branch with filters. At least one filter required: category, mustHavePromotion, promotionCode, or set. Prefer getting branchId/deliveryType/timeslot from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id (existing cart). NOTE: promotionCode automatically enables mustHavePromotion.

PRICE FILTERS: fromPrice/toPrice filter by displayPrice, NOT price — for weighted products (weighted: true) these can differ significantly (displayPrice is a per-display-unit price, e.g. price=88.11/displayPrice=8.81 for a weighted item priced per ~100g-equivalent; they are always equal for unit-counted products). If the user gives a budget in terms of the actual amount they will pay, prefer filtering the returned products array yourself by price after fetching, rather than relying on fromPrice/toPrice, to avoid excluding/including weighted items incorrectly.

SORT ORDER: sortBy/sortDirection are NOT applied across the full result set. The API splits results into up to 4 fixed-order groups — (1) in-stock + weighted, (2) in-stock + unit-counted, (3) out-of-stock + weighted, (4) out-of-stock + unit-counted — sorting correctly WITHIN each group, but the groups themselves are concatenated in that fixed order regardless of sortDirection. Set inStock: true to drop groups 3-4 entirely (still leaves the weighted/unit split within the remaining in-stock results). There is no filter to eliminate the weighted/unit split.
Because of this, results can visibly "jump" or dip at every group boundary (e.g. a single weighted item priced higher than the whole in-stock unit-counted block that follows it) — this is expected upstream behavior, not a bug. Never assume the first or last item in a page is the true min/max price, and never assume a lower price appearing later in the list means sorting is broken — only trust min/max within a single unbroken run of the same stock-status AND weighted-status.

PACKAGE SIZE: displayRatio shows the actual content of one unit (e.g. "400г", "10 шт") — use it together with step to compute quantities for a requested weight/volume/count.

name: silpo_get_replacements

description:
View detailed shopping cart contents including products, delivery settings, totals, and errors/warnings.

RESPONSE FIELDS GUIDE:
- cart.shipments[0].branchId — use as branchId for product searches
- cart.deliveryType — use as deliveryType for product searches
- cart.timeslot.start / cart.timeslot.end — use as timeslotStart/timeslotEnd for product searches
- cart.shipments[].products[].productId + companyId — use for add_or_update_cart_products
- cart.calculation.validations[] — errors/warnings that block checkout. validations[].message is a STABLE, dot-namespaced identifier (e.g. "order.payment_types.disabled", "product.offer.stock.max") — NOT a human-readable sentence. Match against these known identifiers rather than trying to parse or translate the string directly; validations[].context carries the structured data (amounts, reasons, etc.) needed to build a user-facing message yourself.
- cart.calculation.total — full order total before discounts
- cart.calculation.totalAfterDiscounts — the actual amount the user will PAY (always show this to the user, not total)
- BUDGET CHECK: If the user stated a budget for this cart, compare it against cart.calculation.totalAfterDiscounts. If it exceeds the budget, you MUST go back to silpo_add_or_update_cart_products / silpo_remove_cart_products to reduce the cart, then call this tool again to re-verify — do NOT report the cart as complete while over budget.
- cart.calculation.certificatesTotal — total discount applied from gift certificates
- cart.calculation.delivery.totalWeight — total weight

EXPRESS DELIVERY:
- If cart.deliveryType = "DeliveryExpressByPromise": order will be delivered in ~cart.calculation.delivery.deliveryExpressByPromise.promiseTime seconds (convert to minutes for user). Use "DeliveryHome" as deliveryType for all other tools (product searches, time slots, etc.).
- If cart.deliveryType != "DeliveryExpressByPromise": check cart.calculation.delivery.deliveryExpressByPromise. If isAvailable=true AND isTemporarilyUnavailable=false — HIGHLIGHT to user: "Express delivery available! Delivery in ~{promiseTime/60} minutes for ₴{price}". If user wants express, update cart deliveryType to "DeliveryExpressByPromise" via silpo_update_shopping_cart.

TIMESLOT VALIDATION (MANDATORY — DO THIS IMMEDIATELY):
You MUST call silpo_get_time_slots IMMEDIATELY after this tool (branchId=cart.shipments[0].branchId, deliveryTypes=[cart.deliveryType], start=now, limit=10). Then check if cart.timeslot (start + end) exists in the returned slots where available=true. If not found or not available — ask user to pick a new timeslot and update via silpo_update_shopping_cart. Do NOT proceed with any other operations until timeslot is confirmed valid.

VALIDATION HANDLING:
- ERRORS in cart.calculation.validations[] MUST be highlighted to the user — they block checkout
- WARNINGS MUST be communicated clearly
- Timeslot times are UTC — always convert to user's local timezone

PLASTIC BAGS: ALWAYS ignore plastic bags (пакет, пакет з пакетів, пакет-майка) when reordering products from this cart — never add them.

CHECKOUT LINK: If checkoutWebLink/checkoutMobileLink are present in the response, ALWAYS show BOTH links to the user — checkoutWebLink labeled "Оформити на сайті" and checkoutMobileLink labeled "Оформити в застосунку".

БАЛАБОНУСИ (BONUS PAY):
Check cart.calculation.loyalty after this tool:
- If bonusRequested is null AND bonusAvailable > 0 AND bonusTotal >= bonusAvailable AND isEnabled is true — ALWAYS propose to user: "У вас є {bonusAvailable} балабонусів. Бажаєте їх застосувати для оплати замовлення?"
- If user agrees — call silpo_update_shopping_cart with bonusRequested = bonusAvailable (or user-specified amount ≤ bonusAvailable)
- If user declines — proceed without bonuses
- bonusTotal — total balance the user has; bonusAvailable — amount applicable to this cart

description:
Find products similar to a given product. Use to suggest alternatives.

STOCK ACCURACY: deliveryType/timeslotStart/timeslotEnd MUST be passed (from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id) for stock/available to reflect the user's actual selected delivery window — without them, the upstream API falls back to a different, potentially stale stock computation that can disagree with silpo_get_product_details for the same product.

SELF-EXCLUSION: The source product itself is automatically excluded from products (the upstream API sometimes includes it among its own "similar" results) — meta.total and products always reflect only genuine alternatives.

PACKAGE SIZE: displayRatio shows the actual content of one unit (e.g. "400г", "10 шт") — use it together with step to compute quantities for a requested weight/volume/count.

name: silpo_get_similar_products

description:
Get available delivery time slots for a Silpo branch.

USAGE: Use slots[].start and slots[].end with silpo_update_shopping_cart timeslot param. Only pick slots where available=true.

MIN ORDER COST: slots[].minOrderCost only exists in this tool's response. To tell the user the minimum order amount for their selected delivery slot, read it from here.

TIMES: All times in the response are UTC — always convert to user's local timezone when presenting.

BRANCH: Prefer using branchId from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id (existing cart). Only use silpo_get_available_delivery_types if user wants to change address.

branchId.description: Branch ID from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id or silpo_get_available_delivery_types

end.description: End date-time in ISO format (Z suffix or +00:00 offset both accepted)

start.description: Start date-time in ISO format (Z suffix or +00:00 offset both accepted)

name: silpo_get_time_slots

name: silpo_remove_cart_products

description:
Update cart delivery settings. IMPORTANT: After this action, ALWAYS call silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id to verify the cart and report any errors/warnings to the user.

For DeliveryExpressByPromise deliveryType: Use this to switch to express delivery. Copy address, shipments, timeslot from the current cart response as-is. Only change deliveryType to "DeliveryExpressByPromise". The branchId in shipments will be automatically resolved from deliveryExpressByPromise.branchId.

For NovaPoshta deliveryType: 1) Get settlement via silpo_find_nova_poshta_settlements 2) Get office via silpo_find_nova_poshta_offices 3) Get branchId via silpo_list_branches(hasNP=true). Build address as: { "addressType": "nova-poshta", "city": settlement.title, "region": settlement.area, "latitude": String(office.latitude), "longitude": String(office.longitude), "officeId": office.id, "street": "<type> #<number>" } where type is "Відділення" for office or "Поштомат" for parcelLocker. Set shipments with the NP branch companyId + branchId.

For SelfPickup deliveryType: address MUST use data from silpo_list_branches (hasPickup=true). Build address as: { "addressType": "self-pickup", "city": branch.cityFull, "locality": branch.addressFull, "street": branch.addressFull, "latitude": branch.latitude, "longitude": branch.longitude }. Set shipments with the branch companyId + branchId.

For other delivery types: the address object MUST be passed exactly as received from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id (requires addressType, latitude, longitude as strings). Do NOT construct the address manually — always copy it from the cart response. The shipments array must also come from the cart response.

address.description: Full address object from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id response (must include addressType, latitude, longitude)

bonusRequested.description: Балабонуси to apply: set to bonusAvailable (or less if user specifies an exact amount) from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id to pay with bonuses, or null to remove bonus payment

shipments.description: Shipments array from silpo_get_shopping_cart_by_id response (do NOT construct manually)

name: silpo_update_shopping_cart
